questions.q: From which country did the Maldives gain independence in 1965?
questions.why: It had been a British protectorate.

questions.q: Which 2004 disaster hit the Maldives?
questions.why: Many islands were flooded.

questions.q: Who ruled the Maldives as President from 1978 to 2008?
questions.why: He was Asia's longest-serving leader.

questions.q: Who is the national hero who drove out the Portuguese in 1573?
questions.why: National Day honours his victory.

questions.q: Which 1988 coup attempt was stopped with India's help?
questions.why: India's mission was called Operation Cactus.

questions.q: Which bridge opened in 2018 links Malé to the airport island?
questions.why: It was built with Chinese help.

questions.q: What is the capital of the Maldives?
questions.why: It is one of the most crowded cities in the world.

questions.q: How many coral islands does the Maldives have?
questions.why: Only about 200 are lived on.

questions.q: Which ocean are the Maldives in?
questions.why: They lie southwest of India.

questions.q: Which big gentle fish do divers see in Ari Atoll?
questions.why: It is the world's largest fish.

questions.q: Which bay in Baa Atoll draws huge numbers of manta rays?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO biosphere reserve.

questions.q: Which glowing effect lights up Maldivian beaches at night?
questions.why: It is called a 'sea of stars'.

questions.q: Which artificial island was built to ease crowding in Malé?
questions.why: It was built on reclaimed land.

questions.q: Which island was turned into a rubbish island near Malé?
questions.why: It is called 'Rubbish Island'.

questions.q: What is the only Maldivian island to stretch over a natural freshwater lake?
questions.why: It is a single-island atoll.

questions.q: Which drum music and dance is a national tradition?
questions.why: It means 'big drum'.

questions.q: Which President held a cabinet meeting underwater in 2009?
questions.why: It drew attention to climate change.

questions.q: Who became President of the Maldives in 2023?
questions.why: He was mayor of Malé.

questions.q: What is the official religion of the Maldives?
questions.why: It converted in 1153.

questions.q: What is the currency of the Maldives?
questions.why: Its code is MVR.

questions.q: Which threat does the Maldives face as the world's lowest country?
questions.why: Its average height is about 1.5 m above sea level.

questions.q: What language is spoken in the Maldives?
questions.why: It is written in Thaana script.

questions.q: Which Moroccan traveller was a judge in the Maldives in the 1300s?
questions.why: He married there.

questions.q: Which European power held Malé for 15 years in the 1500s?
questions.why: Muhammad Thakurufaanu drove them out.

questions.q: What shells were the Maldives famous for exporting as money?
questions.why: They were used as money across Asia and Africa.

questions.q: Which ring-shaped coral formations make up the Maldives?
questions.why: There are 26 natural atolls.

questions.q: Which type of hotel room is famous in the Maldives?
questions.why: They stand on stilts over the lagoon.

questions.q: Which fish is the main catch of the Maldives?
questions.why: It is caught by pole and line.

questions.q: Which spicy tuna and coconut paste is eaten for breakfast?
questions.why: It is eaten with flat roti.

questions.q: Which old mosque in Malé is built of coral stone?
questions.why: It was built in 1658.
